notes: document-viewer is the prose-bearing card — same grounding rule as report-card. The body field is `content` (markdown or HTML), NOT `body_markdown`.

title: info-card (simple notice — no metrics, no sources required)

data.title: Maintenance window
data.body: The next migration window starts at 03:00 UTC. Expect 5 minutes of degraded read latency.

notes: info-card takes title + body + optional variant (info|success|warning|danger). No sources field — it's a structured notice, not grounded prose.

title: list-card (small structured list of items)
notes: Items must be objects with at least `label`. Optional per-item: description, icon, action. `ordered:true` renders a numbered list.

title: metric-card (single number with trend)
notes: value accepts string OR number. trend enum: up|down|flat. Renders to bottom drawer by default; pass render_target="" to inline.

title: progress-card (progress bar with step checklist)
notes: progress is a number 0–100 (validator enforces). Each step requires `label` + `done` (boolean).

title: table-card (sortable data table)
notes: Each column needs `key` + `label`. Row keys must match column keys; rows are open-shape (additionalProperties allowed).

title: timeline-card (vertical timeline of events)

events.label: Root cause identified — bad config push

notes: Each event requires `timestamp` (ISO 8601) + `label`. status enum: completed|active|pending.

title: diff-card (side-by-side before/after comparison)

after.label: Proposed (v3.3)
after.content:
max_attempts: 5
backoff: exponential
base_ms: 100
jitter: true

notes: before and after are objects, each requiring `label` + `content`. format enum: text|code.

title: force-inline a card whose schema would default to a drawer
notes: Empty render_target overrides the schema's default_render_target so the card renders inline in chat instead of the bottom drawer. Distinct from omitting the field (which uses the default).

title: REFERENCE — session-task (NOT emitted via nanite_show_card; backend-only)

data.title: Run quarterly capacity audit
data.description: Cross-check Datadog headroom against forecast in planning/q3-capacity.md.

notes: REFERENCE ONLY: session-task is registered for validation but NOT in the nanite_show_card allow-list. Emitted by the chat engine through a different path. Field shape shown so callers/components emitting it match the schema. status enum: pending|in_progress|completed|failed|cancelled.

title: REFERENCE — error-report (NOT emitted via nanite_show_card)
notes: REFERENCE ONLY: error-report is runtime-emitted by the harness on tool/provider failures. Field shape shown so error pipelines match the schema. All four required fields (code, message, giphy_query, timestamp) must be set.

title: REFERENCE — approval-card (decision-flow envelope; emitted by approval pipeline)

data.details: Includes the OAuth scope-narrowing change discussed in PR #218. Rollback plan: redeploy v3.6.2 — 2 min cutover.

notes: REFERENCE ONLY: approval-card is a decision-flow envelope, not addressable through nanite_show_card. Emitted by the approval pipeline. Field shape shown for callers building approval flows. risk_level enum: low|medium|high.

title: REFERENCE — proposal-card (decision-flow envelope)

payload.title: Patch Redis client to handle MOVED redirects

notes: REFERENCE ONLY: proposal-card carries a draft action with editable fields. Emitted by the proposal pipeline, not nanite_show_card. The outer `type` is the proposal kind (e.g. create_task); the envelope `type` is `proposal-card`.

title: REFERENCE — question-form (interactive form envelope)

questions.prompt: What environment should we deploy to?

notes: REFERENCE ONLY: question-form is the InterviewCard envelope. Emitted by the interview pipeline, not nanite_show_card. Each question requires prompt + type + required. type enum: text|textarea|select|radio|checkbox.
